# Why the pending tray is finally smaller

We gave Rafi authority to refuse unsuitable repairs and the pending tray emptied. The new labels helped, but the decision changed the work. [[Field methods]]: do not attribute the outcome to the visible artefact when an invisible permission changed at the same time. Write both interventions in the record.
